question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which was your favorite part about Regime Change?
Do you think Angie and $Scott should try to get back together?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: I talked to some of the students you tried to recruit, and no one is interested.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Keep up this lackluster performance, and you'll find yourself out of a job.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Now I'm not sure I should entrust you to do anything more.
$Scott leaves the locker room.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That was terrible... I'm really not on my A-game right now.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That could've gone better...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Two out of three isn't too shabby.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That went great! I got all three of them!
Suddenly, Principal Dyre comes up behind $Scott!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Respect? What's that?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Respect is being able to roam the halls and have people get out of your way. Respect is people explaining everything they're talking about to you.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Respect is having people laugh at your jokes.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: That sounds cool. I like respect. And remembering rules. I could totally be `The Force!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That sounds cool. I like respect. And remembering rules. I could totally be [color=#e23b3b][i]The Force![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, you could even be `The Enforcer!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, you could even be [color=#e23b3b][i]The Enforcer![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: That's what I said!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No, those are two different words...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Words again, who needs those? I'm in! Thanks!
Zach slaps $Scott hard across the back on his way out.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Ow. Great. Ow.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: They'd fear me? People fear monsters, and I'm not a monster.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That's true. You're not.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: So what are you saying? I don't want people to `fear` me.
nodes.text_bbcode: So what are you saying? I don't want people to [color=#e23b3b][i]fear[/i][/color] me.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Listen, if that's the best you've got, I'm going to work out now. Don't bother me anymore with that C.R.E.E.P. stuff, `creep!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen, if that's the best you've got, I'm going to work out now. Don't bother me anymore with that C.R.E.E.P. stuff, [color=#e23b3b][i]creep![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, whatever you say.
Hannah pats $Scott's cheek and goes back to the stage to rehearse.
$Scott heads to the locker room where Zach is talking to some other jocks.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: So then I told her, it's not cleave, it's `cleave!`
nodes.text_bbcode: So then I told her, it's not cleave, it's [color=#e23b3b][i]cleave![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I don't get it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's hilarious!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I don't get it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry, Zach. I guess you had to be there.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Don't worry about it, Zach. It's just words. Come on, Howard. Let me tell you about the rest of the date.
Howard and Jacob laugh as they walk out, leaving Zach alone. $Scott approaches him.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: $Scott! Did you come to lift weights with me?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Uh, no. But I did want to ask you about something.
$Scott explains C.R.E.E.P. to Zach.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: You want me to go around enforcing rules? I don't know, man. I'm not into that stuff.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Rules are hard. You have to remember them.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But, someone else will be remembering them for you.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: What's in it for me?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Zach doesn't like to be laughed at, and no one would laugh at him if he had power.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Do it for power, Zach. People would...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You're also good at captivating and charming people. With skills like yours, you would make an amazing spy!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I `am` a great actress! Tell me more about what you like about me.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] a great actress! Tell me more about what you like about me.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Uh, er, okay. You are good at impersonating other people in a dramatic way...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Uh-huh.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And, um, your hair is a red or brown color.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Go on.
And for the next five minutes, $Scott lists Hannah's good qualities.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well, $Scott, it sounds like C.R.E.E.P. would really appreciate my talent and expertise and attractiveness.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: So you'll consider?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yes! Consider me a part of that atrociously-named group! Tres magnifique!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Popular? Spies aren't popular. People will hate being around me.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Huh, I guess you're right. Being a spy will probably make you `less popular.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Huh, I guess you're right. Being a spy will probably make you [color=#e23b3b][i]less popular.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Then why would I want to be a spy?!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I guess you wouldn't.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I don't want to join your group, $Scott. But thanks for the thought.
$Scott goes to the auditorium where Hannah is practicing her lines.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: To be... Or to belie... That is the choice... Oh, hello, $Scott!
Hannah jumps offstage and embraces him.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, Hannah, just the actress I want to see...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Actress? Do you have a role for me?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: As a matter of fact, I do. I want you to become a member of C.R.E.E.P. It's a group that enforces rules at school.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Principal Dyre wants you to gather information for him.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: A spy, huh? That hardly sounds like a part I would play... Why would I want to do this?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: The acting students get enough romantic drama as it is, and power doesn't seem like something Hannah wants.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I guess I should appeal to her ego.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You should do it because...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Girls like uniforms? That's not true.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I already have a football uniform `and` a basketball uniform, and I don't get more girls because of it.
nodes.text_bbcode: I already have a football uniform [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] a basketball uniform, and I don't get more girls because of it.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: So maybe that's not the first reason you should join C.R.E.E.P., but it could still be a good opportunity for you.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I don't know, I'll think about it.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: They do?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah! You don't see girls going for sidekicks in action hero movies, do you?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: That is true...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Of course it is! You see girls going for the main guys, the `leaders.` Which is what you would be for C.R.E.E.P.
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course it is! You see girls going for the main guys, the [color=#e23b3b][i]leaders.[/i][/color] Which is what you would be for C.R.E.E.P.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: This could be great for you. You don't have problems talking to girls, just meeting them. If you join C.R.E.E.P., girls would come to you.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What do you say?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: All right, count me in. I'll see you around, $Scott.
Phil walks away.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That guy! First Principal Dyre, now Justin... Being President isn't as fun as it used to be.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Especially without Angie. But I still want to do a good job, and that means I have to stick it out!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: All right, I have to recruit Phil, Hannah, and Zach for C.R.E.E.P. But I have no idea where they are.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: If only Angie were here... But she's not. I'm going to have to figure that out myself.
After spending an hour obtaining student schedules, $Scott finds Phil in the gym.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, Phil...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Hey, $Scott, did you hear the news? Shapiro's gone! We have a new principal...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: We've met. Actually, that's what I wanted to talk to you about.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: He wants me to recruit people for a new program he's starting, and he thinks you'd be a perfect candidate.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: What program?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: C.R.E.E.P. The Centerscore Rules Enforcement and Engagement Police.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: No offense, $Scott, but I don't want to be a `creep.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No offense, $Scott, but I don't want to be a [color=#e23b3b][i]creep.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: So the name's not perfect, but you'd be enforcing rules, monitoring people, wearing uniforms.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Enforcing rules? What kind of rules will he be instituting?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You know, rules for improving schooling. Like, setting up more study groups and stuff.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Why would I want to do that?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Dyre said to offer something he doesn't have. Well, Phil just broke up with Kim, and I heard he's been practicing flirting with a lot of girls lately...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: He's looking for romance.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You should join C.R.E.E.P. for the girls. Dyre wants to make you the head of the organization. Girls love...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh really?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I don't miss her. I can do everything ten times better without her!
Justin draws a tape recorder from his pocket.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: She'll be sorry to hear that.
Justin runs off.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Justin, you rat!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hah! You lie! ...Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I said, Angie was great, and I miss her. Now more than ever I realize what an efficient, organized, and smart person she was.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And how she made my life as an administrator easier and better.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, that's not going to make very good listening fodder.
Justin slinks off.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Now, for the first reform... I need you to recruit students for C.R.E.E.P.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: For what?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: The `C`enterscore `R`ules `E`nforcement and `E`ngagement `P`olice. This group of students will be implementing the new regime that will be set in place.
nodes.text_bbcode: The [color=#e23b3b][i]C[/i][/color]enterscore [color=#e23b3b][i]R[/i][/color]ules [color=#e23b3b][i]E[/i][/color]nforcement and [color=#e23b3b][i]E[/i][/color]ngagement [color=#e23b3b][i]P[/i][/color]olice. This group of students will be implementing the new regime that will be set in place.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: There are three students I want you to recruit specifically.
The principal hands $Scott a list.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Phil, Hannah, and Zach? Isn't that kind of random?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: For a new regime to work, you need someone with a friendly face, someone on the inside feeding you information, and someone to keep the peace.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: So Phil's your charmer, Hannah's your spy, and Zach's your hired muscle?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: An interesting way to put it.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And just how am I going to convince them to join C.R.E.E.P.?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Offer them what they don't have. There are three things all teenagers are tempted by: power, romance, and admiration.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Figure out what your victims want and use it against them.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I don't know if I like taking advantage of people.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: The first step to making order is taking advantage. In any case, I wasn't asking for your opinion. I was commanding you to do as you're told.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Now listen here...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Maybe I haven't made myself clear. Make these reforms work, or you'll be out of office.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: I already know someone else who's willing to take up your role as President.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Is his name Justin?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: It doesn't matter who. The point is, there is someone who `will` create these changes, even if you `don't.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It doesn't matter who. The point is, there is someone who [color=#e23b3b][i]will[/i][/color] create these changes, even if you [color=#e23b3b][i]don't.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I can't let Dyre or Justin win. Besides, if I get kicked out, there's no way I'll be able to change anything!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Now, don't you have some students to recruit?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yes, sir.
$Scott leaves the principal's office.
$Scott is on his way to Auto-Shop when Justin appears.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Gah! What hole did you slither out of, Justin?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Trouble in paradise, eh?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I don't know what you mean.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I heard you broke up with Angie.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, so?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I also heard you don't know why she did it.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You seem to be hearing a lot for having very few friends.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I bet she probably got tired of you slacking off as President and wanted someone with more... Ambition.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I have plenty of ambition. In fact, I just left Principal Dyre's office. He entrusted me with a new, very important Presidential task.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: My point is... What are you possibly going to do without your Secretary, $Scott? How is life without Angie?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Let's not play around here, $Scott.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: I could have you deposed by the time the door hits your back on the way out.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Now, are we going to have any problems?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: That's 'No, sir'.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No, sir.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: That's better.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: That's what I like to hear.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: It's good to see someone with the right mindset.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: I'm sure this will be the start of a very amicable relationship between you and me, $Scott.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Anytime, man.
$Scott leaves the house and walks home.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Not being with Angie anymore isn't great, but there's nothing I can do about it.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Maybe I should move on. And I know exactly how I'm going to do that!
The next morning at school, $Scott strides into the principal's office!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Principal Shapiro! I have ideas for changing the school!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: What is the meaning of this intrusion?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Who are you? Where's Shapiro?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: I'm Victor Dyre. I'm the new superintendant of the district, and I'm taking over Centerscore as acting principal.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Who are `you?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Who are [color=#e23b3b][i]you?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: $Scott, the student body President.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Ah, President. How fortunate. I was just about to summon you.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Summon me?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: My job here is simple. Turn Centerscore around.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Are we doing that badly?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Centerscore is a disaster! Test scores are less than exemplary, and all the while, students walk freely through the halls, talk during lunch, and express their opinions.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: It's my job to put order into this school, and it's your job to support me in doing that.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Actually, it's my job to `help` the students of Centerscore.
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, it's my job to [color=#e23b3b][i]help[/i][/color] the students of Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: This `will` help the students.
nodes.text_bbcode: This [color=#e23b3b][i]will[/i][/color] help the students.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Now I have some reforms I'd like to implement by the end of the day, and you will help me convince the students to be a part of them.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: What do you say to that?

nodes.prompt: What do you say to that?

options.label: What did you have in mind?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you say to that?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sorry, but Hector's right. I just need to forget all about her.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's right, dawg. Go out there and make out with a girl. Heck, make out with `two!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's right, dawg. Go out there and make out with a girl. Heck, make out with [color=#e23b3b][i]two![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm not sure I'm ready for `that`...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not sure I'm ready for [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sure, sure. So you don't want to make out with a girl. But you can `call` one, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: Sure, sure. So you don't want to make out with a girl. But you can [color=#e23b3b][i]call[/i][/color] one, right?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What?
Hector puts a phone into $Scott's hand.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Call someone hot. Just so you know other girls exist. What about Jessica?
$Scott dials Jessica's number.
The phone rings and rings until...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $Scott, how's it going? I'm so glad you called!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You are? I mean, I'm glad I called `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You are? I mean, I'm glad I called [color=#e23b3b][i]you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hee hee. I was just talking to my friend, who's totally in college, and saying she just had to come to one of your parties!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I told her $Scott's parties are, like, `the best` parties ever!
nodes.text_bbcode: I told her $Scott's parties are, like, [color=#3b78e2][i]the best[/i][/color] parties ever!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Wow, thanks, Jessica. I do have a lot of fun throwing parties.
$Scott and Jessica talk for several minutes.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: So you and the squad are getting shakes at Cheese-Teasers after the game on Friday?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: ...Yeah, I'm down to go. It'll be awesome! Thanks for inviting me. See you around, Jessica!
$Scott hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Did that feel liberating or what?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, it did.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Anyway, it's late. I'm going to get some sleep. School tomorrow. Thanks for cheering me up, guys.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: A grand romantic gesture, huh?
The boys walk to Angie's house.
$Scott props a ladder against Angie's bedroom window while Hector and Howard hide in a nearby bush.
$Scott starts strumming a guitar.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: { Can't survive without you... {
Angie's window opens.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is your chance! Tell her how you feel!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Anj, I...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott, I'm sorry, but it's almost midnight. And I'm pretty sure my dad just armed his crossbow...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Angie, listen, I wanted to tell you...
Suddenly, the lights turn on! $Scott hears the whistle of arrows flying past his head!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Run!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Run![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, that was a disaster.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Who knew how poorly you could sing and how well Angie's dad can shoot an arrow from ten yards away?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry. But you don't think she was a little touched?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Touched in the head maybe. I told you, you should just move on.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I just don't know if there's another girl out there for me.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Anyway, it's late. I'm going to get some sleep. School tomorrow. Thanks for trying to cheer me up, guys.
If you like `Surviving High School`, be sure to check out our studio's newwest game, `Cause of Death`, now available in the app store!
nodes.text_bbcode: If you like [b]Surviving High School[/b], be sure to check out our studio's newwest game, [b]Cause of Death[/b], now available in the app store!

nodes.text: Angie's broken up with $Scott, and to top it all off, there's a new principal at Centerscore who wants to make some radical new changes!
Can you help $Scott institute these reforms to create the new regime? Let's find out!
One Sunday night, as $Scott and Howard are hanging out at Hector's house.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Would you rather kiss $ZOE, or...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not this again. The answer is always 'I'd rather kiss $ZOE'! How is it that whenever I come over here, we play this game?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Maybe because it's a classic game?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's not what we're here for. $Scott, how are `you` holding up?
nodes.text_bbcode: That's not what we're here for. $Scott, how are [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] holding up?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Good, good.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I meant, about Angie. I heard that you two broke up.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh, that. Yeah, I'm totally fine. I mean, I admit it sucks, but I'm taking it well.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You sure?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I think he's more than sure. That's the right attitude, $Scott. Just shake it off and put yourself right back on that shelf.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: On the shelf?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You know, back on the market shelf. The shelf in the super market. Oh, forget it. Point is, you're free to do whatever you want.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: If I were you, I'd be calling every single girl I know right now.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know if that's the best way to get over Angie. It seemed like you were pretty good together...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Isn't it worth trying to get her back? Shouldn't you go make some grand sweeping gesture?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Stuff like that only works for you, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I didn't see you try to move on when you realized you were in love with Amanda when she was dating someone else.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: In fact, didn't you change your New Year's party around just to see her?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It doesn't matter what we think. What do `you` think, $Scott?
nodes.text_bbcode: It doesn't matter what we think. What do [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] think, $Scott?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Dyre wants you to be driving experts! Instead of Auto-Shop in the afternoon, you'd escort some students to and from their after-school activities.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Why are we supposed to like this?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Not only do you get out of your academic classes... But you'd get to drive students around for school credit.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I don't know if I like that idea. What kind of students?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Uhm, some of the nerds and jocks. You'd be taking them to tournaments, to their home after hours, stuff like that.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: This doesn't sound like fun, $Scott.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, some of the jocks are rich.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: That just means we'd be driving snotty, spoiled rich kids around.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, but don't think of it as driving the `rich kids` around... Think of it as driving the rich kids' `cars` around!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, but don't think of it as driving the [color=#e23b3b][i]rich kids[/i][/color] around... Think of it as driving the rich kids' [color=#e23b3b][i]cars[/i][/color] around!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Their cars? Like Zach's blue Ferrara?!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I've always wanted to race Taylor's red Biscotti 9 series around SkyTrack!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And that will work... As long as Taylor's in it.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Well, maybe that won't be so bad...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Glad to hear that.
Megan and Kenji walk away discussing the rich kids' cars. Spike approaches $Scott.
$Scott is just about to report to Principal Dyre when he runs into Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Perfect. Just perfect. It's been a `great` day. Dyre wants to reform the school, and everyone seems reluctant to make changes.
nodes.text_bbcode: Perfect. Just perfect. It's been a [color=#e23b3b][i]great[/i][/color] day. Dyre wants to reform the school, and everyone seems reluctant to make changes.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know what to do about Dyre and the school, but I've been thinking, and I have advice for you about Angie.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $Scott, it's obvious you're really affected by her. You two were really good together. And she suddenly breaks up with you for no reason?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So maybe a dramatic, romantic gesture won't win her back, but I still think you should talk to her.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You know, it's funny. Going through changing the school, implementing the reforms, trying to find people in the right classes...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It makes me realize...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Just like the game, you get experience and more skills.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, that does sound kinda cool.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You can level up in all sorts of things... Not just fighting orcs or lifting things...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But in cooking and driving and powering up in sports!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I'm more excited about that. Life's never sounded more like a game!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Thanks for hearing me out, guys.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What are you saying? Life is like a game? All games come to an end?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Our lives are ending?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Strictly speaking, that's true...
And for the next hour, the nerds ponder their lives.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Where do we go when we die?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: They say we go back to become part of the earth in which we developed... But physics says our energy is conserved...
And later...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Do you think cryopreservation will be possible by then?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That will be entirely unnecessary with new medical advancements...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: All right, guys, can we forget I brought this up? There's a ban on games, and unfortunately, the decision is out of my hands.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: A fate worse than death...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm sure you guys will find a way to play games outside of school. Thanks for hearing me out.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, it's not really up to you guys.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: There's no vote?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No, but listen, it's not going to be all bad.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: How is that not going `to be bad?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: How is that not going [color=#e23b3b][i]to be bad?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Look, guys... You don't have to spend your time playing online games all the time. Life is like a game.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And, in life...

options.label: All games must come to an end.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: They want to put a ban on gaming at school.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Online, board, or video?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I didn't know there was more than one... But let's go with 'all of the above.'

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But how will I play Space 'Splosions during lunch?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You won't.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Thanks for being completely honest.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I know the administration never looked favorably on gaming as an appropriate extracurricular activity for brains such as ourselves, but...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: They want to stop us from having fun completely?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And why should we agree to a complete ban of gaming at school?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What? Cut back? What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, instead of being able to play games all the time and meet in groups to talk about gaming strategies...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You may have to play it `some` of the time and meet `less` to talk about it.
nodes.text_bbcode: You may have to play it [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] of the time and meet [color=#e23b3b][i]less[/i][/color] to talk about it.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: How much less? Are we talking four strategy sessions a day instead of five?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Er, no, that's not quite what I meant...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: 20 hours a week instead of 40?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: When do you have enough time to play 40 hours a week?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I sleep like a bat.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: All right, I mean like playing zero hours a week and not meeting at all.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: There's `a complete ban on gaming?!` You should've just told us that in the first place.
nodes.text_bbcode: There's [color=#e23b3b][i]a complete ban on gaming?![/i][/color] You should've just told us that in the first place.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I see that now.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And why should we agree to this ban?
$Scott finds the nerds in the library.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Listen to this, guys, I just made it to second base with Dinah!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What?! When?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Last night. We've been talking about moving forward, and last night, I finally leveled up enough...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Only thirteen more bases to go and the Twin Swords of Rotheiel will be ours! That's a +2 added to every roll against an opponent!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I was not expecting that conversation to go there...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: $Scott, what brings you to our meeting?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I wanted to talk. We have a new principal, and there are going to be some changes coming that will particularly affect you.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What kind of changes?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I know how attached they are to gaming... If I tell them there's a gaming ban, I don't know how they'll react...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I could not make it sound as bad, but I should probably tell them the truth...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, you see, Principal Dyre thinks that test scores would go up with some change, especially because you guys play Warscrewdriver Online so much. This means...

options.label: There's a complete ban on gaming.
You might have to cut back.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Really? I always knew I deserved to be on camera.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yes, really... Think of it as practice for when you become famous.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hee hee. I'd better start dressing better for school then.
Taylor walks away, posing for every camera in the hallway.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I can't believe that worked!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Really? It's supposed to save us from ourselves? Like a camera's going to save me when I fall off the top of the cheer pyramid?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Maybe not like that...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Or when I'm about to run into my locker... Or get brown highlights...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I don't think that's the camera's job.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Then how is it for our safety? Tell me that, $Scott.
Taylor walks away angrily, and every camera in the hallway swivels to follow her.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I can't believe that just happened!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: I just saw two Auto-Shop students destroy the school hallways, tearing down posters and yelling profanities.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: You're not getting me what I want! I'm not sure you're up for the task I've set forth for you.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: But I still see some potential in you. You have one last chance.
As $Scott heads away from Auto-Shop, he runs straight into Principal Dyre!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Not really, but if I don't help out, Dyre'll throw me out of office.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: So I feel like I can do more as President than not. I don't like this new program or some of the other reforms, but maybe I can help with other changes later.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Okay, so these reforms aren't `great,` but I guess it's good to know you're still on our side on the `inside.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, so these reforms aren't [color=#e23b3b][i]great,[/i][/color] but I guess it's good to know you're still on our side on the [color=#e23b3b][i]inside.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, of course.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Centerscore is a disaster. Our test scores are low! Dyre just wants to make it a more successful school for everyone.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: That's crap. I didn't vote for you because you promised us awesome parties... Though you did throw some `awesome` parties.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's crap. I didn't vote for you because you promised us awesome parties... Though you did throw some [color=#e23b3b][i]awesome[/i][/color] parties.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I voted you in to help us. And instead you just sold out. I can't stand you right now.
Spike shakes his head in disgust and walks away.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Spike, wait!
Spike ignores him and leaves the Auto-Shop.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Ugh, how can this day get any worse?!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Dyre wants you to be... Servants!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That's not what I meant. I mean, you would just be, uhm, kind of driving other kids around.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And maybe if you drive them around enough, they might tip you!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Wow, $Scott, that's just degrading.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It's good vocational training?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: So we're not smart enough to be in classes now?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I thought you didn't like class.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I like to have the option of hating it.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Okay, maybe when you point it out like that...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You know what? Forget Dyre! Forget school!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah!
Megan and Kenji storm out as Spike approaches $Scott.
In Auto-Shop, $Scott sees Megan, Spike, and Kenji.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, guys.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hey, Prez, is it true Dyre's canceling P.E.?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Um... I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Lot of good you are. Why are you even here?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I have something that Dyre wants me to ask you.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: What is that?
A new program that might replace Auto-Shop...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: `Replace Auto-Shop?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Replace Auto-Shop?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'd better tread carefully. They won't like driving people around... I should try to make the job sound cool!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Dyre wants you to be...

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: And aside from that, my biggest problem is your attitude. I've been keeping my eye on you. You're not spirited enough or dedicated enough to be worthy of staying in power.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm sorry to hear that, sir. But I disagree. I think I know what the `real` problem is.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sorry to hear that, sir. But I disagree. I think I know what the [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] problem is.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: I don't want your excuses.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm not going to give you any. What this school needs is a firm hand, Principal Dyre.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No amount of my running around convincing students to do something they're not responsible enough to do is going to change things.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And it doesn't matter how spirited `I` am, if other students aren't fully committed to the cause.
nodes.text_bbcode: And it doesn't matter how spirited [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] am, if other students aren't fully committed to the cause.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Go on.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: We need to be harsher on the students. We don't need their approval.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Their free will is what's making it hard to institute reform. I say we crush it.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Really? That's what you think?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Excellent. My boy, this is going to be the start of a very good friendship.
$Scott's about to become a ruthless dictator?! This is an awful ending!
Try again and see if you can stop $Scott from selling everyone else out!
And don't forget to join us on facebook.com/survivinghighschool to tell us what you thought of this episode and discuss SHS with other fans!

args.text: Surviving High School
Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That I don't need Angie at all.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I was fine without her. I figured everything out by myself. Sure, she made things easier, but I'm not exactly pitiful without her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But she wasn't just there for you as a Secretary. What about as a girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Why do I need her when there are more girls out there who `want` to be my girlfriend?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why do I need her when there are more girls out there who [color=#e23b3b][i]want[/i][/color] to be my girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No, I don't have to talk to Angie. I never needed her in the first place.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right, fine. Just trying to help.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Stop. Okay?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Riot! Riot! Riot!
$Scott turns around to find a giant crowd of students around the principal's office!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Whoa, guys, what's going on?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: There he is!
All the students suddenly turn to $Scott!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Look, `Prez,` we've been talking, and it seems like there's been a lot of talk about change going on. Change that we don't like.
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, [color=#3b78e2][i]Prez,[/i][/color] we've been talking, and it seems like there's been a lot of talk about change going on. Change that we don't like.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: They're the principal's changes...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Instituted by the `President.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Instituted by the [color=#e23b3b][i]President.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I don't want to join the C.R.E.E.P.s, and I don't want to recruit people for some dumb organization that's going to make us have mandatory study hall.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And Auto-Club isn't going to drive your precious nerds around. We're not slaves for you to order around!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If the cameras aren't here because we're movie stars, they shouldn't be here at all!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Did we stop when the Sea Lion King launched an assault against the Lutrine Kingdom?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Only when we ran out of mana and potions. But then we pressed on!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We're not giving up gaming without a fight!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Howard! Some help here?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I thought you wanted me to stop giving you advice!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Can we try that later? Right now, give advice! `Give advice!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Can we try that later? Right now, give advice! [color=#e23b3b][i]Give advice![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: He's talking too much! Don't let his words confuse you! Get him!
The mob swarms $Scott and carries him off.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Whoa, hey, where are you taking me?!
Uh-oh. Looks like $Scott has his hands full with an all-out school riot! And without his friends or Angie to back him up!
This isn't the type of school reform $Scott wanted! Try again and see if you can put $Scott's life back in a bit more order!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: I was skeptical at first of your ability to accomplish anything, but after what I've seen today, I feel your trajectory is on a good track.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Great! So we can talk about the changes I want to make now, right?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: What kind of changes?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, sir, for starters, the gaming ban is too tough. I talked to the nerds about it, but it would be more fair if you let them play during lunch at least.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Maybe that was a stretch. What about having a partner program where the nerds tutor the Auto-Shop in exchange for their driving services?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, what can I change then?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: You can decide whether the new detention room wall colors will be gray or grayer.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Listen, I'm sure you're full of ideas. But we have real work to do.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Replacing art and history with mandatory study hall, instituting formal SAT Prep time instead of Winter Formal...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Dyre, I can't. I quit.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: I'm sorry to hear that. I encourage you to reconsider what you're giving up.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: We can forget all about this incident if you take back what you've said right now.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No way! You don't want a President, you just want a puppet.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm resigning. I don't believe in the changes you're making, and I just don't like you.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: `You`... You might come to regret that, young man.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You[/i][/color]... You might come to regret that, young man.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Not anytime soon.
$Scott opens the door to the office...
...And runs smack into Justin

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Owwww!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hah! I knew the job would be too hard for you to handle, $Scott.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I just wish your head hadn't been. Owww...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I knew it was just a matter of time before you bumbled without your precious `Secretary girlfriend` watching your back!
nodes.text_bbcode: I knew it was just a matter of time before you bumbled without your precious [color=#e23b3b][i]Secretary girlfriend[/i][/color] watching your back!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Were you eavesdropping?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Not eavesdropping... Waiting for my opportunity.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Whatever. You're right. This job is not what I wanted. Have at it, Justin. The Presidency's yours.
Justin sidles in as $Scott marches outside.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Students of Centerscore! Nerds and rebels, preps and jocks! Listen to me!
A crowd forms around $Scott.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I talked to a lot of you today, asking you to participate in Principal Dyre's new reforms.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But no more! Nerds, you should be free to game as much as you choose.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Rebels, Spike was right. You should be going to class and learning in Auto-Shop.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You shouldn't be content to be chauffeurs, driving students around, no matter how good their cars are.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You got that right, $Scott!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And everyone that I talked into joining C.R.E.E.P... Well, stop that. That's a terrible name for a club anyway.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Yeah, it is!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I say, forget these reforms!
Dyre steps in front of $Scott, and a hush falls over all the Centerscore students at once.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: `You've said enough.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You've said enough.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Dyre waves his hand, and Skazz and Stiletto suddenly flank $Scott, grabbing both his arms.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Skazz? Stiletto? What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: They're here to enforce `peace.` Haul him to Boot Camp.
nodes.text_bbcode: They're here to enforce [color=#e23b3b][i]peace.[/i][/color] Haul him to Boot Camp.

nodes.text: Skazz and Stiletto start dragging $Scott away.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Wait, no! `Noooo!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, no! [color=#e23b3b][i]Noooo![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Good bye, $Scott. I'll take great care of the school without you.
Uh-oh, looks like $Scott's in major trouble... And after he'd just resigned as President!
And meanwhile, Dyre and Justin are going to take over Centerscore and turn it into the new Wilson!
Well, this may not sound like the good ending, but this time, it is!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I love you, Angie.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I know. Good bye, $Scott.
$Scott walks away.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Sniffle... Sniffle...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, that was sweet.
Justin appears from a hiding place behind a music rack.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Sniff... I hope you're happy, Justin. Now where were we? Right, you were giving me that USB drive.
Justin hands Angie the drive, and she breaks it.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Now don't forget our deal. I still have copies of that photo on every backup server I own.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I don't get it. You want the Presidency. All you had to do was show the picture to Shapiro or Dyre, and he'd be suspended and most likely deposed.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: The Presidency would be up for grabs. Why did I have to break up with $Scott?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You're the reason he gets out of every scrape. Without you, he's less than half a man. A quarter of one, in fact!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You're still not answering my question.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Without you, he'll fall apart as President. I won't have to use the picture to get rid of him. He'll hand me the Presidency himself.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: With the new regime, I just hope the Presidency dies before you ever get it. Good bye, Justin.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm sorry, for whatever it is I did.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott, I already told you. It has `nothing to do with you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: $Scott, I already told you. It has [color=#3b78e2][i]nothing to do with you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: If it were up to me...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, it's not. So just... Just leave me alone.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Thank you for everything. You were... Are really awesome.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And you were an awesome girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I don't think I ever knew how much you meant to me until now.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: How much I need her.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I just saw her. She's in the music room. You should go to her.
$Scott runs to the music room where Angie is hurriedly putting away instruments.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Angie? I didn't know you were taking band.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: I, uh, well, transferred in. Did you want something?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Angie, everything seems to be falling apart. Principal Dyre wants to make changes, and I don't feel good about them.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott, you became President because you wanted the student body to have fun, and if the job's not allowing you to do what you want... You don't have to stay President.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But I doubt you want to hear me talk about our principal's dubious principles. Why are you really here?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: To see you. And to ask you why we broke up.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I already told you that I can't tell you. But trust me when I say that it's for a good reason. And believe me, it has `nothing` to do with you.
nodes.text_bbcode: I already told you that I can't tell you. But trust me when I say that it's for a good reason. And believe me, it has [color=#3b78e2][i]nothing[/i][/color] to do with you.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Angie...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: $Scott, we need to talk. What do you think about this new program?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, I'm not exactly excited about it...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: $Scott, you're having the guys in Auto-Shop chauffeur other people around instead of taking classes.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, it's not `my` idea.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, it's not [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] idea.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But you're the one convincing everyone to do it. Did you hear what Dyre's up to? He wants to turn our garage into a 'study lounge'!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But what about Auto-Shop class?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Great question, $Scott. I was going to ask you about it.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Do you really like what Dyre is doing to the school?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: But I have another task for you.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: I want you to convince the Neanderthals in the Auto-Shop that they will now be taking their welding time to escort our higher-performing and higher-contributing students to their after-school activities.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You want the rebels to drive the nerds and rich kids around?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: That's a crude way to put it, but that is what it distills down to.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I admit it, I'm the first to say people should forget homework and party, but shouldn't the Auto-Shop students still be in class?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: No use letting our best and brightest students, the ones with the highest chance of success, dirty their hands when the lower-performing students could use the vocational training.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That doesn't sound right.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Need I remind you that there is a more interested and qualified student seeking to claim your position?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Fine. I'll do it.
$Scott walks to Auto-Shop.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: There's one other thing I need you to do.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Come on, one more thing? I don't even like these reforms.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: We need the students with high GPAs to excel.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: If they have high GPAs, aren't they already doing pretty well?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: 'Pretty well' is not good enough. I need them to perform `perfectly` on their standardized tests. So I'm implementing a ban on online gaming at this school.
nodes.text_bbcode: 'Pretty well' is not good enough. I need them to perform [color=#e23b3b][i]perfectly[/i][/color] on their standardized tests. So I'm implementing a ban on online gaming at this school.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: You will be convincing the nerds to support and adhere to that ban.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Maybe I don't understand gaming, but I do understand that gaming is important to the nerds.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm not sure I like what's going on at the school, Principal Dyre. Recruiting students willingly to join a club is okay.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But turning Auto-Shop into a driving service? And banning games?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You can't take Warscrewdriver Online away from Brendan or Dexter!

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Can't I? Listen here. You will stop asking questions and cooperate with me, or you'll experience something unpleasant.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What, you're going to kick me out of office?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Don't take that lightly. Let me tell you something, $Scott. If you're not President, it'll be a lot harder to help your friends.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: `Help` them?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Help[/i][/color] them?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: It would be unfortunate if disruptive students, like your friends Hector and Howard, were to suffer for violating the new school codes.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Boot Camp is getting pretty harsh, I hear.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Are you threatening them?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: I don't threaten. I persuade. Now, don't you have somewhere else to be?
$Scott is heading to the library when Taylor comes up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $Scott, what's going on?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I got a warning that a new principal was coming, and I come to school, and there are cameras everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What's up?
$Scott looks up and sees cameras positioned at every eave in the roof, rotating smoothly from left to right.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Dyre's setting up cameras? This is a bad omen. I don't want to freak Taylor out.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh, uh, they're installing them...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I was fine without her. I figured everything out by myself. Sure, she made things easier, but I'm not exactly pitiful without her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But she wasn't just there for you as a Secretary. What about as a girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Why do I need her when there are more girls out there who `want` to be my girlfriend?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why do I need her when there are more girls out there who [color=#e23b3b][i]want[/i][/color] to be my girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No, I don't have to talk to Angie. I never needed her in the first place.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right, fine. Just trying to help.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Stop. Okay?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Riot! Riot! Riot!
$Scott turns around to find a giant crowd of students around the principal's office!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Whoa, guys, what's going on?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: There he is!
All the students suddenly turn to $Scott!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Look, `Prez,` we've been talking, and it seems like there's been a lot of talk about change going on. Change that we don't like.
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, [color=#3b78e2][i]Prez,[/i][/color] we've been talking, and it seems like there's been a lot of talk about change going on. Change that we don't like.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: They're the principal's changes...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Instituted by the `President.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Instituted by the [color=#e23b3b][i]President.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I don't want to join the C.R.E.E.P.s, and I don't want to recruit people for some dumb organization that's going to make us have mandatory study hall.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And Auto-Club isn't going to drive your precious nerds around. We're not slaves for you to order around!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If the cameras aren't here because we're movie stars, they shouldn't be here at all!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Did we stop when the Sea Lion King launched an assault against the Lutrine Kingdom?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Only when we ran out of mana and potions. But then we pressed on!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We're not giving up gaming without a fight!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Howard! Some help here?

nodes.text: I thought you wanted me to stop giving you advice!

The mob swarms $Scott and carries him off.

nodes.text: I'm impressed with your work, $Scott.

In the morning, students gather in front of their lockers to await disciplinary action.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Violators of any school statutes will face serious consequences.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Amanda and Spike, step forward.

nodes.text: For violation of Protocol-30 which clearly states that hair colors must be acceptably hued, you shall work twenty hours of community service.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But my hair is natural...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: So is mine.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Rubbish.
And in classes that day...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: It saddens me to say that we're enforcing a new rule. All students must wear their GPAs on their shirts.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: GPAs between 4.0 or higher must adjourn to the library where Principal Dyre will have you take individual study with personal tutors.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: GPAs 3.0 or higher must stay in this classroom where we will be continuing class as usual.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Everyone under a 3.0 must report to Auto Shop for driving duty...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, Ryan, that's upside down... You got a 1.6.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Oh...
And after school, Phil walks into the gym where Hannah and Zach are waiting for Principal Dyre to show up.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Hey guys.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Phil? What are you doing here? I thought you agreed with $Scott that the reforms should be forgotten.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Yeah well. I thought about it. Dyre's here and $Scott's not. I'd rather be here as part of C.R.E.E.P. than hauled away to Boot Camp.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: A wise choice.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Anyway, I've been thinking about a slogan. What about, 'Feeling creepy? Join the C.R.E.E.P.s!'

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Dah-ling, I don't think that's quite what we're going for.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Hey, just stick to figuring out which students are going to be against us. I'll be the one recruiting from now on.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: And I'll do the retentioning. Retening. Retentionating.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Retaining?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Stick to your spy stuff.
Phil, Hannah, and Zach go quiet as Principal Dyre enters the gym.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: Stand up straight, you three. We have potential recruits coming in any minute now.
At that moment, Jean Paul walks into the gym, looking expectant.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: I am here for the `crepe` meeting?
nodes.text_bbcode: I am here for the [color=#e23b3b][i]crepe[/i][/color] meeting?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Wrong! We're a club, not some `food.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wrong! We're a club, not some [color=#e23b3b][i]food.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: Then I am in, how do you say, the 'wrong place'?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: What is the meaning of this?

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: What is the meaning of what?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: You have an accent, you dress sharply for a boy, and there is the lingering smell of French toast on your breath.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: It is because I am French! I am a foreign exchange student.

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: We'll have to see about exchanging you back.

nodes.speaker: Jean Paul
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Principal Dyre
nodes.text: No foreign sentimentals in an American school of mine!
Principal Dyre hauls Jean Paul out of the gym!
